name: Derelict: Station Kestrel
author: Patchwork
description: Science fiction. A mining station gone dark: your docked shuttle, a medical bay, a reactor deck and a cargo hold, plus generated corridors, maintenance shafts and hydroponics, and ship directions (fore, aft, port, starboard). Supplies the station AI WARDEN, a doctor, an engineer and a quartermaster with full profiles, keycards, couplings and medkits, card readers, keypads and dead lifts, station lore, and three events (a rogue AI, a saboteur, an outbreak), so no two runs tell the same story.
